name: OSS_EVENT_TYPE_ATTRIBUTES
description: Following table is used to capture event type attributes.

columns.name: EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of usage event type attribute.

columns.name: EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Alternate key for usage event type attribute.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture event type id.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Field used to capture object name.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture attribute id.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Field used to capture attribute name.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture balance attribute data type.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the source type of event type attributes.

columns.name: EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture event attribute type.

columns.name: PRICING_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Obsoleted : This field tracks the name of pricing entity object associated with the balance predicates.

columns.name: PRICING_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Obsoleted : This field tracks the name of pricing entity attribute associated with the balance predicates.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
